newsitem.title: FRANCE: Societe General says Q1 activity good.
newsitem.headline: Societe General says Q1 activity good.

text.p: Societe General chairman Marc Vienot said on Tuesday the French bank's figures for first quarter operations had been "very encouraging."
"On the basis of (the first) three months and even of the first four months of 1997, activity has been very encouraging," he told a shareholders' annual meeting.
He indicated that business had been good in both the international and domestic divisions, adding that financial market activities had been "clearly good."
He also said that French bank Credit National was on the road to recovery.
